import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String userInput = scanner.nextLine().trim();

        // Replace 'dot' with '.' in the middle of the string
        String modifiedInput = userInput.charAt(0) +
                userInput.substring(1, userInput.length() - 1).replace("dot", ".") +
                userInput.charAt(userInput.length() - 1);

        // Replace first occurrence of 'at' with '@' in the middle of the string
        int atIndex = modifiedInput.indexOf("at");
        if (atIndex != -1 && atIndex != 0 && atIndex != modifiedInput.length() - 2) {
            modifiedInput = modifiedInput.substring(0, atIndex) + "@" + modifiedInput.substring(atIndex + 2);
        }

        System.out.println(modifiedInput);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
